sentences.text:
Respondent :- Union Of India And Another
Counsel for Petitioner :- Avinash Jaiswal,Radheshyam Yadav,Surendra Kumar Verma

Counsel for Respondent :- A.S.G.I.
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Ram Manohar Narayan Mishra,J.
1.

Heard Shri Radheshyam Yadav, learned counsel for the petitioner and Shri Prem Narayan Rai,
learned counsel for respondents.
2. The following prayer has been made in the present petition:
"(i) To issue a writ in the nature of mandamus directing the respondent no.2 to issue fresh Passport to the petitioner for which Application Reference No.25-0054457404 Vaibhav Agrawal vs Union Of India And Another on 10 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/82383409/
1 has been filed before the respondent no.2 on 10.06.2025.
(ii) To issue a writ in the nature of mandamus directing the respondent no.2 to decide the representation of petitioner dated 20.06.2025."
3. The passport has not been issued to the petitioner apparently in view of pendency of a criminal case against the petitioner bearing Case Crime No. 43 of 2015 under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468 and 471 IPC.
4.

entities.text: Vaibhav Agrawal vs Union Of India And Another on 10 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
It has been held by a Coordinate Bench in Writ-C No. 41540 of 2023 (Pawan Kumar Rajbhar vs.
Union of India and 2 others) and other connected matters decided on 19.01.2024 that in such an event, it is open to the person concerned to seek no-objection from the jurisdictional criminal court in respect of grant of passport and the Regional Passport Officer shall act, accordingly.

entities.text:
Pawan Kumar Rajbhar vs.
Union of India and 2 others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. In view of the aforesaid position, we dispose of the writ petition with liberty to the petitioner to apply before the concerned court for no-objection and in case, the same is granted, the Regional Passport Officer shall proceed to take further action in the matter taking into notice the no-objection granted by the court.
(Ram Manohar Narayan Mishra, J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta, J.) Order Date :- 10.7.2025 Ankit.
